record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.context_brief: Large invariant set containing Mather dynamics
record.original_question: Can one generically find a closed connected invariant set F inside H^{-1}(1) that contains all supports of ergodic minimizing measures, has the property that orbits asymptotic to locally minimizing orbits are dense in F, and for which the restricted Hamiltonian flow on F has a dense orbit?

evidence.quote: Can one find C∞-generically a closed connected set F, invariant by the Hamiltonian flow fHt of H, F ⊂ H−1(1), such that F contains all the supports of the ergodic minimal measures, in F the orbits asymptotic to the locally minimal orbits are dense in F, and on F, fHt|F has a dense orbit ?

artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface related work on Aubry–Mather theory, weak KAM, and generic properties of Tonelli Hamiltonians, but no result establishing the existence of such a closed connected invariant set $F$ with all three properties generically. The problem appears in a well-known list of open problems in dynamical systems and there is no indication in the literature that it has been resolved.

status_evidence.title: The link between the shape of the Aubry-Mather sets and their Lyapunov exponents
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses structure of Aubry and Mather sets for Tonelli systems without resolving the generic existence of a transitive invariant set containing all minimizing supports.
status_evidence.claim: Related research on Aubry–Mather sets does not address this exact generic transitivity question.

status_evidence.title: Ann. Scuola Norm. Sup. Pisa - Generic properties of Tonelli Hamiltonians
status_evidence.snippet: Studies generic Tonelli Hamiltonians and their Aubry/Mather sets.
status_evidence.claim: Available generic results do not produce the connected, transitive invariant set with asymptotic density of minimizing orbits required.
